card_says: Independent power producer created in 2008 to build and run the plant; the project's implementing agency and borrower under the guaranteed loans.
source_says: MIGA records that Globeleq holds 56 per cent of KPDC and the government of Cameroon 44 per cent, Globeleq having bought the shares formerly held by AES; the guarantee for that investment was issued on 12 June 2014. The card's wording does not reflect the change of majority owner in 2014.

source_says: The company's filing with the National Stock Exchange of India gives the registered name as KEC International Limited, of Mumbai, the flagship company of the RPG Group. "KEC India" is not its registered name.

source_says: The company's own site gives the name as Wärtsilä Corporation, listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. The card drops the diacritics.

card_says: Named as "Siemens France", preferred bidder with KEC India for the transmission line and substation contract.
source_says: Siemens' own French press material names the local entity as Siemens SAS and, in its boilerplate, Siemens France Holding, a subsidiary of Siemens AG. "Siemens France" is a descriptive label rather than a registered company name.

company: Ministère de l'Équipement et des Transports, Mali
card_says: The ministry that published the compensation and resettlement framework for the Malian sections of the corridor and held the Bamako to Bougouni and Sikasso to Hérémakono works.
source_says: A ministry of that title existed when the decree of 5 November 2002 set out ministers' duties. By the decree of 4 September 2012 its duties had been split between a Ministry of Equipment and Territorial Development and a Ministry of Transport and Road Infrastructure, so for the later years of the corridor works no ministry carried this title.

source.title: Décret n°2012-486/P-RM du 4 septembre 2012 fixant les attributions spécifiques des membres du Gouvernement, Journal Officiel

card_says: The national roads directorate of Argentina, inside the public works ministry.
source_says: The agency's own page describes it as a decentralised body under the transport secretariat of the Ministry of Economy. A decree of 7 July 2025 began a reorganisation of decentralised agencies including Vialidad, with its authorities continuing their functions until new structures are approved. It sat under the public works ministry at the time of the case.

card_says: The state joint-stock company that took full ownership and management of the Balakhani landfill on 14 October 2009.
source_says: The company's own site adds that a presidential order of 22 September 2021 placed Tamiz Shahar under the management of Azerbaijan Investment Holding, and that collecting and carrying Baku's household waste remains with the Baku City Executive Power rather than the company.
